svg.title: Weighted locality-data recovery. For a fixed nonzero sector retain its amplitude and photon coordinates. Its horizontal wave readout is the same q, so every weighted norm in TR31 is un- changed. Writing k = (k1, . . . , kn), one has Q i(1 + |ki|) ≥1 + maxi |ki|; choosing 2d large enough therefore bounds that product weight by a constant times the inverse radial weight furnished by polynomial ball growth. In particular Cauchy–Schwarz gives the explicit integrability budget Z |q| Y i (1 + |ki|)−d−2dλn
